preliminary_evidence_judgment: Read before seat scores. MONDAY mines 20K YouTube mobile how-to videos (iOS/Android) into 313K annotated frames: GroundingDINO phone isolation, OCR-based scene transitions (F1 95.04), GroundingDINO+OCR element boxes (hit ratio 99.87, a lenient 'any box contains the target' bound), and a 3-step GPT-4o action identifier using neighbouring frames and narration (80.9% all / 91.8% touch on 100 human-annotated videos; 80.4% human-judged accuracy on training samples). Downstream: SeeClick and Llama-3.2 get an extra LoRA stage on MONDAY, then AitW or AMEX fine-tuning; offline action matching on AitW/AMEX/MONDAY and a 50-video Windows Mobile set (unseen OS). Gains on Windows Mobile are 12-23 points, but there is no equal-data/compute control, no platform ablation, single runs, and the abstract's 18.11 average does not equal the table's 17.99. The paper's contribution is a training-data resource, so component_training applies. Applicable: gui R03 (C02 on the annotator side); E15, E26, E27, E28.
agreed_items_review: Agreed items M=3, X=3, E.holdout=2, E.statistics=1, evidence_level offline, claim_support scoped, rs C08 partial were re-checked: all stand. The 18.11 vs 17.99 arithmetic was verified from Table 5.

assessment.evidence_level_note: All downstream results are offline action matching; the unseen-platform set is offline and human-annotated.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported: the pipeline labels actions at 80.9% (touch 91.8%) on 100 human-annotated videos at about $0.34/video, and an extra LoRA stage on MONDAY raises offline action-matching accuracy of SeeClick and Llama-3.2 on an unseen Windows Mobile set by 12-23 points (mean 17.99, single runs), without an equal-data control.
not_supported: Attribution to cross-platform diversity rather than extra data/training
Superiority over equal amounts of other data
'Consistently' better on all test sets (SeeClick AMEX column regresses)

G.reason: Concrete bottleneck (manual annotation cost, obsolescence, missing iOS/configuration diversity) with dataset-level lineage (Table 1: RICO, AitW, Video2Action, Chen et al.) and the tutorial-replay neighbour discussed in the appendix; residual (automated multi-platform real-video extraction at scale) is bounded. Nearest video methods are not run (no code), keeping it below 4.

M.reason: OCR text is more OS/theme-stable than pixels, SoM boxes offset VLM localisation error, narration+neighbour frames+zoom disambiguate, each with an ablation; the unaddressed ~20% label noise and the assumption that offline matching reflects navigation ability keep it at 3.

X.reason: Filtering funnel, OCR/transition thresholds, detection heuristics, zones, training hyper-parameters and the unified action space are given; GPT-4o prompts and code are not released and there is no label-confidence gate.

E.measurement.reason: Pipeline metrics use dual human annotation with adjudication (3.93% disagreement), but action labels are built on the pipeline's own scene segmentation, ambiguous cases are excluded, the hit ratio is a lenient bound, and the downstream metric is offline exact matching restricted to shared action types (78-94% of actions).

E.causality.reason: Pipeline ablations (1/2/3-step, narration, single image) are clean, and the with/without-MONDAY comparison holds on two backbones and two fine-tune sets; but no equal-size alternative-data or equal-compute arm and no platform ablation, so attributing gains to cross-platform diversity rather than extra data/training is open.

E.holdout.reason: Windows Mobile is a genuinely unseen platform, human-annotated independently of the pipeline; video-level splits; decontamination only by 30-character title overlap; offline only.

E.statistics.reason: Test sizes and annotator disagreement reported; all downstream results single-run without intervals; abstract average 18.11 vs table 17.99; the AMEX regression is not discussed.

E.cost.reason: Collection cost ($6,976 total, $0.34/video vs $5.76 manual) and preprocessing time are reported, but training compute is given only in epochs and the MONDAY arm's extra training stage is not budget-matched against any alternative.
